svg.title: PhyloFunctionLens pipeline metro map
svg.desc: A two-column animated metro map of the PhyloMine / PhyloFunctionLens Nextflow pipeline. Stage 1 and stage 2 form a vertical shared trunk in the left column. Stage 3, stage 4 and stage 5 are stacked from top to bottom in the right column; stages 3 and 4 keep their parallel tool fans, and stage 5 stays compact below them.
svg.text: QC ≥70% completeness · ≤5% contamination · GTDB R232 reps (--level) · rooted tree
single-copy OGs ≥8 spp · MMseqs2 70% reps · assets / clean_OG / filtered_OG
clean_OG representatives · 5 parallel annotations + BAKTA → BAKTFOLD
per-genome assets · 5 parallel searches + antiSMASH → BiG-SCAPE
Tip: run with -resume to reuse cached stages.
